title: Find Interview Candidates
summary: Return name and mail of users who won any medal in three consecutive contest IDs, or won at least three gold medals overall.
inputFormat: Contests(contest_id, gold_medal, silver_medal, bronze_medal); Users(user_id, mail, name).
outputFormat: Columns name, mail for qualifying users, each once.
edgeRules: Consecutive means consecutive contest_id values, not consecutive rows; the draft does not state this.

examples.label: authored-reference
examples.text: authored-reference: user wins medals in contests 5,6,7 -> qualifies; user with 3 gold in non-consecutive contests -> qualifies.
